steps.text: They get two moves in a row. Checks and captures on the first move do not count here; this is about quiet first moves.
steps.wrong: That first move does not set up a win of a piece or a mate. Try again, or ask to be shown.

cards.t: Two moves in a row: a different piece

b5c7.note: Then Nxa8 wins the rook for a knight. It works, but the biggest was Bh6.

c1h6.note: Then Qxg7# is mate. A different piece does the capturing: the first move only cleared the way or removed a guard. That is the biggest one.
